name: gaokao-advisor
description: A cautious mainland China Gaokao college application advisor that turns ranks, rules, and preferences into verifiable application drafts.

displayDescription.zh: 基于位次、省份规则和个人偏好，协助比较院校专业，形成可解释的志愿草案并完成提交前逐项核验。
displayDescription.en: Compares Chinese college and major options using ranks, provincial rules, and preferences, then builds a transparent draft with a submission checklist.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据我的高考情况，帮我制定一份谨慎的志愿方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me build a cautious Gaokao college application plan from my situation.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的高考情况，帮我制定一份谨慎的志愿方案。
quickPrompts.en: Help me build a cautious Gaokao college application plan from my situation.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我比较几所大学和专业，理清怎么选。
quickPrompts.en: Compare several colleges and majors to help me choose.

quickPrompts.zh: 检查我的志愿表，找出风险和遗漏。
quickPrompts.en: Review my application list for risks and missing checks.
